brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
@buildthis.bisks.net cee didn't specify distance so can you build a page that takes your location as input and gets the temperature of the nearest cities and points compass-like in the direction of the warmest one

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @cee.wtf: A compass that points in the warmest direction]
note: built warmward: no distance specified, so it checks the 8 nearest cities (from ~8.4k worldwide) and swings a compass needle at whichever's warmest right now.
